description: This file defines a collection of notification presets for an Android wearable notifications project, including classes for building various styles and types of notifications with specific configurations.

classes.name: NotificationPresets
classes.description: A collection class holding static predefined notification presets and helper methods for building notifications.

classes.name: NotificationPreset
classes.description: An abstract base class for different notification presets, providing structure for building notification arrays.

classes.name: BuildOptions
classes.description: Configuration options used when building notifications within presets.

methods.name: applyBasicOptions
methods.description: A helper method to apply common options to a notification builder, including title, text, icon, intents, and flags.

methods.name: buildNotifications
methods.description: Abstract method implemented by subclasses to build and return an array of notifications.
